what: GF08: multi-camera sync by capture timestamp in a master-clock player (G9), exactness only; no timing fields

conventions.P_source: nominal_fps 30 in corpus/index.json for both sets; P = 33,333,333 ns
conventions.PREV: k = largest i with ts[i] <= T. T < ts[0] -> none (before_start). k = last and T - ts[k] > P -> none (after_end). Else frame k; hold_stale if T - ts[k] > P.
conventions.NEAREST: k = argmin |ts[i] - T|, ties -> smaller i. If 2|ts[k]-T| > P: none (before_start / after_end) when T < ts[0] / T > ts[last], else hold_stale (in a gap). Else frame k.

identity.jpeg: SHA-256 of the Range-fetched bytes, looked up in that camera's own table; ImageDecoder decode complete + 1280x720
identity.jpegbc: 16-bit pattern cam*4096 + k read from the ImageDecoder output
identity.h264: 16-bit pattern cam*4096 + k read from the WebCodecs VideoFrame (flush after each chunk)

conventions.mismatch: identity mismatch = expected none but page decoded something, or read id != expected k, or (barcode paths) read cam != cam, or decode failed
